title: %assert — validate a condition
purpose: Return the condition value when truthy, otherwise null, for inline validation.
notes: Passes the condition through when truthy; a failing assertion yields null (~) and the transform continues.
An optional second string argument is a diagnostic message and does not appear in the output.

avoid.why: the quoted infix string is a literal, and a non-empty arbitrary string is not one of the truthy tokens, so the assertion fails and yields null. Pass a real condition like %gt @.amount ##0.
